$comment: agent-loop configuration — see README.md. Repo paths are relative to the working directory the runner is launched from; use absolute paths if you schedule it from elsewhere.

backend.disabledReason: No baseline here yet (CI, test harness, PR template), and branch protection requires a named human bypass, so agents cannot land work here unattended. Build the baseline before enabling.

$keepAwakeNote: Holds a Windows SetThreadExecutionState wake lock for the duration of the run, released automatically on exit (including Ctrl-C or a crash) — so the machine only stays up while a run is actually in flight, with no permanent powercfg change to undo. The display is still allowed to sleep. No-op on non-Windows hosts. Set false if you manage sleep yourself (PowerToys Awake, powercfg, a server that never sleeps).

queue.$comment: linear | generated | linear-then-generated. Drains the DoR-ready Linear backlog first; self-generates only if the queue comes up short.

budgets.$comment: Mirrors the agent contract / dispatch Modes. Wall-clock and dollars are hard-enforced by the runner; token and tool-call figures are advisory and passed into the worker prompt. Caps derived from observed tickets.

concurrency.$comment: Parallel dispatch is operator policy. The runner supports up to N workers in flight, file-disjoint by planner guarantee, worktree-isolated, git bookends serialized. Merge train stays sequential. Failures count in completion order; stop conditions stop launches and let in-flight tickets finish. First raise watched, not unattended.

merge.$comment: Auto-merge into rc only. Enable only once the e2e gate runs against the live RC deploy. TWO switches must be true: 'enabled' is the policy, 'verifiedGateOk' is your attestation that you have seen a clean unattended run and still trust the gate. Set verifiedGateOk to false any time you want PRs queued for review instead - the runner refuses to merge without it, whatever 'enabled' says.
merge.$orderingNote: One race is open by design: e2e-happy-path is not sequenced after deploy-web.yml's RC deploy, so a fast push can exercise the previous build. The runner closes it - after each merge it waits for the deploy to finish, then triggers e2e against the build that actually shipped, and halts the whole train if that goes red.

supervisor.$comment: Checkpoint supervisor: review gate on every green PR before merge-train eligibility, failure triage instead of the blind two-failure counter. Advisory inside hard fences — cannot raise budgets, touch merge config, or unblock escalations. enabled:false restores pre-supervisor behavior exactly.

claude.$permissionNote: acceptEdits auto-approves edits but still prompts on Bash, so an unattended worker cannot run lint/typecheck/test and escalates instead of opening a PR. bypassPermissions is bounded by disallowedTools below — deny rules are enforced in every mode, bypassPermissions included.
claude.$toolNote: gh pr merge is denied to WORKERS deliberately. Merging is the runner's job, after its own verification - never a worker's, even when everything looks green.
